title: Nuevas voces
goal: Read a closing look at Indigenous political representation's late-1990s growth, the 2007 UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples, and the persistent poverty gaps and resource conflicts alongside these gains.

items: Describe the growth in Indigenous political representation.
State what the UN approved in 2007 and its legal status.
Explain what gaps persisted alongside these advances.
Describe the trend in resource-project conflicts.
Use a la vez que to link two simultaneous processes.
